must_know.zh: 美国拟对进口无人机及零部件征收高达100%关税并对华加征新关税，多方表示反对。
must_know.en: The US plans tariffs of up to 100% on imported drones and new tariffs on China, drawing widespread opposition.

must_know.zh: 中国国常会通稿首次使用“国家队”、类“平准基金”提法，释放稳股市信号。
must_know.en: China's State Council used the terms 'national team' and a quasi stabilization fund for the first time, signaling support for the stock market.

must_know.zh: OpenAI反诉苹果窃取商业机密，AI竞争进一步升温。
must_know.en: OpenAI countersued Apple over alleged trade secret theft, intensifying the AI race.

stories.title_zh: OpenAI反诉苹果窃取商业机密
stories.title_en: OpenAI countersues Apple over trade secrets
stories.summary_zh: OpenAI对苹果提起反诉，指控其窃取商业机密，AI竞争进一步升温。
stories.summary_en: OpenAI has countersued Apple, alleging trade secret theft as competition in the AI race intensifies.

stories.title_zh: 特斯拉AI5芯片量产或推迟
stories.title_en: Tesla AI5 chip mass production may be delayed
stories.summary_zh: 报道称特斯拉AI5芯片难以在明年量产，在台积电产能争夺中输给谷歌和微软。
stories.summary_en: Tesla's AI5 chip may not enter mass production next year, reportedly losing out to Google and Microsoft in the race for TSMC capacity.

stories.title_zh: 谷歌发布新一代TPU
stories.title_en: Google unveils new-generation TPU
stories.summary_zh: 谷歌发布新一代TPU，有开发者认为真正重要的并非芯片本身。
stories.summary_en: Google released a new generation of TPUs, with some developers saying the chip itself is not the most important part.

stories.title_zh: 三星重组芯片部门强化AI
stories.title_en: Samsung revamps chip division for AI edge
stories.summary_zh: 三星电子重组芯片业务部门，以强化其在人工智能领域的竞争力。
stories.summary_en: Samsung Electronics has reorganized its chip division to sharpen its competitiveness in artificial intelligence.

stories.title_zh: 洛杉矶学区屏蔽谷歌AI功能
stories.title_en: LAUSD blocks Google AI features
stories.summary_zh: 洛杉矶联合学区屏蔽谷歌AI功能，此前谷歌威胁削减学校搜索访问权限。
stories.summary_en: The Los Angeles Unified School District blocked Google AI features after the tech giant threatened to cut schools' search access.

stories.title_zh: 国常会首提“国家队”稳股市
stories.title_en: China cabinet signals 'national team' to steady markets
stories.summary_zh: 国常会通稿首次使用“国家队”、类“平准基金”提法，11月内两场国常会提及资本市场。
stories.summary_en: China's State Council used the terms 'national team' and a quasi 'stabilization fund' for the first time, with two meetings in November addressing capital markets.

stories.title_zh: 日本通胀高企 12月加息预期升温
stories.title_en: Japan inflation keeps December rate hike in play
stories.summary_zh: 日本关键通胀数据居高不下，市场对央行12月加息的预期进一步升温。
stories.summary_en: Japan's key inflation data remained elevated, strengthening expectations that the central bank will raise rates in December.

stories.title_zh: SpaceX首份财报：增收未盈利
stories.title_en: SpaceX revenue up but not profitable
stories.summary_zh: SpaceX首次公布财报，显示营收增长但尚未实现盈利。
stories.summary_en: SpaceX released its first-ever earnings report, showing higher revenue but no profit.

stories.title_zh: 央行拟降大额存单认购起点
stories.title_en: PBOC proposes lower threshold for large CDs
stories.summary_zh: 央行就大额存单管理办法征求意见，个人投资人认购起点拟降至不低于10万元。
stories.summary_en: The People's Bank of China is seeking feedback on new large-denomination CD rules, proposing to lower the individual subscription threshold to 100,000 yuan.

stories.title_zh: 央行完善贷款罚息规则
stories.title_en: PBOC revises loan penalty interest rules
stories.summary_zh: 央行将贷款罚息规则从“加收30%—50%”改为由借贷双方“协商确定”。
stories.summary_en: The PBOC changed loan penalty interest rules from a 30%-50% surcharge to being determined through negotiation.

stories.title_zh: 美国新关税措施遭多方反对
stories.title_en: New US tariffs draw widespread opposition
stories.summary_zh: 美国拟对进口无人机及零部件征收高达100%关税，并对华加征新关税，中国商务部及多方表示反对。
stories.summary_en: The US plans tariffs of up to 100% on imported drones and components and new tariffs on China, drawing opposition from China's Commerce Ministry and others.

stories.title_zh: 中国暂停部分关键材料对美出口管制
stories.title_en: China to suspend some critical-material export curbs
stories.summary_zh: 据报道，中国将暂停部分关键材料对美出口管制，直至明年1月。
stories.summary_en: China will suspend some critical-material export controls on the US until January, according to reports.

stories.title_zh: 泽连斯基不满特朗普称普京“朋友”
stories.title_en: Zelenskyy pushes back on Trump's 'friend' remark
stories.summary_zh: 泽连斯基批评特朗普称普京为“朋友”，并敦促美国对俄施压；特朗普称普京可来美参加G20。
stories.summary_en: Zelenskyy criticized Trump for calling Putin a 'friend' and urged US pressure on Russia; Trump said Putin is welcome at the G20 in the US.

stories.title_zh: 特朗普对加拿大50%关税生效
stories.title_en: Trump's 50% tariffs on Canada take effect
stories.summary_zh: 特朗普对加拿大加征的50%关税生效，加拿大总理卡尼誓言报复。
stories.summary_en: Trump's 50% tariffs on Canada took effect, with Prime Minister Carney vowing to retaliate.

stories.title_zh: 扎波罗热核电站与霍尔木兹局势紧张
stories.title_en: Tensions rise over Zaporizhzhia and Hormuz
stories.summary_zh: 核监督机构就扎波罗热核电站发出新警报；伊朗加大霍尔木兹海峡袭击。
stories.summary_en: The nuclear watchdog issued a new alert over the Zaporizhzhia plant, while Iran stepped up attacks in the Strait of Hormuz.

stories.title_zh: 歼35A首次近距离静态展示
stories.title_en: J-35A makes first close-up static display
stories.summary_zh: 歼35A在珠海航展首次进行近距离静态展示，引发关注。
stories.summary_en: The J-35A fighter jet was displayed statically up close for the first time at the Zhuhai airshow, drawing attention.

stories.title_zh: 八部门印发服务贸易“十五五”规划
stories.title_en: Eight departments issue services trade plan
stories.summary_zh: 八部门联合印发服务贸易发展“十五五”规划。
stories.summary_en: Eight Chinese government departments jointly issued the 15th Five-Year Plan for services trade development.

stories.title_zh: 国考今日开考
stories.title_en: China's national civil service exam begins
stories.summary_zh: 2027年度中国国家公务员考试今日开考。
stories.summary_en: China's national civil service examination for 2027 started today.

stories.title_zh: 酒店拒40岁以上顾客入住引争议
stories.title_en: Hotel's over-40 guest ban sparks debate
stories.summary_zh: 浙江嘉兴一酒店称40岁以上不能入住是老板规定，预订平台无醒目提示，引发合法性质疑。
stories.summary_en: A hotel in Jiaxing, Zhejiang, said its owner set a rule barring guests over 40, with no prominent notice on booking platforms, sparking debate over legality.

stories.title_zh: 济南医保直播人员辱骂咨询者
stories.title_en: Jinan insurance staff insults caller on livestream
stories.summary_zh: 济南医保官方视频号工作人员误以为直播结束，骂咨询者“脑子有病”，医保局称已批评教育并要求道歉。
stories.summary_en: A staffer on Jinan's medical insurance livestream, thinking it had ended, insulted a caller; the bureau said it criticized and disciplined the employee and demanded an apology.

stories.title_zh: 特朗普官员拟在新国会前开特别会议
stories.title_en: Trump officials plan special meeting before new Congress
stories.summary_zh: 特朗普官员计划在新一届国会就职前召开特别会议，加快推进总统项目。
stories.summary_en: Trump officials plan to hold a special meeting before the new Congress is seated to speed up the president's projects.

stories.title_zh: 白宫为“金穹”寻求50亿美元
stories.title_en: White House seeks $5B for Golden Dome
stories.summary_zh: 白宫在临时拨款法案中为“金穹”导弹防御项目寻求50亿美元资金。
stories.summary_en: The White House is seeking $5 billion for the Golden Dome missile defense program in a stopgap spending bill.

stories.title_zh: 白宫拟界定超加工食品
stories.title_en: White House moves to define ultraprocessed foods
stories.summary_zh: 白宫在MAHA计划下着手界定超加工食品。
stories.summary_en: The White House is moving to define ultraprocessed foods under the MAHA plan.

stories.title_zh: 特朗普政府抨击白宫UFC赛事诉讼
stories.title_en: Trump administration blasts UFC event lawsuit
stories.summary_zh: 特朗普政府严厉抨击试图阻止白宫UFC赛事的诉讼。
stories.summary_en: The Trump administration lambasted a lawsuit seeking to stop a White House UFC event.

stories.summary_en: DHS Secretary Markwayne Mullin regrets leaving the Senate and White House aides have soured on him, sources said.
